days.title: Partenkirchen Culture and Panoramic Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ludwigstraße
stops.detail: Ludwigstraße in Partenkirchen: once a commercial street, today a promenade, regional jewel and picture book.

stops.name: Gasthof Fraundorfer
stops.detail: One example of many: the “Gasthof Fraundorfer”, a well-known and popular inn.

stops.name: Philosophenweg
stops.detail: There is a beautiful view over both places from the Philosophers' Trail.

stops.name: St. Anton
stops.detail: It leads from the Wank cable car valley station to the pilgrimage church of St. Anton, past benches whose backrests are adorned with special sayings.

days.title: Garmisch Gardens and Alpine Meadows
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kochelberg
stops.detail: In this mountain world, on the Kochelberg at an altitude of about 900 metres, Ursula Höger has her meadow full of alpine flowers and medicinal herbs.

stops.name: Schneggensteg
stops.detail: Follow Kramerstraße, cross the wooden Schneggensteg and reach Loisachstraße.
